GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
